name: stackfolio
description: Open-source stack organizer and ATS-safe resume PDF generator

scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @stackfolio/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @stackfolio/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @stackfolio/api exec prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @stackfolio/api exec prisma migrate reset --force
